data.gender_notes: Damiano is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'damianus', meaning 'to tame' or 'to subdue'. In Christian tradition, Saint Damiano was a monk who lived in the 6th century and is believed to have founded the Order of Friars Minor. The name Damiano carries the meaning “Tamed or Controlled” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Damiano usually hope their child will grow to embody tamed or controlled and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Damiano total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Damiano carries a rich heritage as it is derived from the Latin word 'damianus', which in turn means 'to tame' or 'to subdue'. This historical meaning has had a profound impact on culture, particularly in the context of the Christian faith. Damiano is the name of revered saint from the early Christian period, who is said to have founded the Order of Friars Minor. As a monk, Damiano exemplified the virtues of humility, simplicity, and obedience. His name encouraged early Christians to tame their desires, to subdue their impulses, and to follow the will of God. To this day, the name Damiano is a reminder of the transformative power of faith and commitment to a higher calling.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Damiano lies in its deeper meaning: to tame or to subdue. Christian tradition tells us that Damiano, a humble monk, chose to dedicate his life to following the will of God and living in faithful obedience. By embracing a life of devotion and surrender, Saint Damiano became an inspiration for others to do the same. As a result, the name Damiano carries with it an encouragement to explore the inner world, to conquer our own desires and to submit ourselves to the love and guidance of God. This spiritual significance has continued to inspire and influence generations, offering a constant reminder of the importance of staying faithful and committed to the call of the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Damiano, meaning "to tame or subdue," is a name that resonates with the spiritual journey of Christians. It symbolizes the call to submit our will to God's and to transform our passions and emotions, making them instruments of love and service to others.
